applications.name: AssetScreener
applications.title: Asset Screener
applications.description: Screens instruments and publishes the current selection as an fdc3.instrument context on the joined user channel.

applications.name: RiskEngine
applications.title: Risk Engine
applications.description: Scores instruments broadcast on the user channel, publishes elginwhite.riskAssessment alternatives, and can submit elginwhite.tradeProposals to OMS.

applications.name: OrderManagement
applications.title: Order Management
applications.description: Order Management System (OMS) for trade execution. Turns elginwhite.tradeProposals into orders and broadcasts fdc3.order updates.

applications.name: Portfolio
applications.title: Portfolio
applications.description: Portfolio management view. Presentation only — this app does not currently use the FDC3 API.

applications.name: DesktopBridge
applications.title: Desktop Bridge
applications.description: WebSocket bridge that proxies native desktop applications into the FDC3 environment. Connects to the Desktop Agent via getAgent() and relays DACP on behalf of each desktop app.

applications.name: MicrosoftTeams
applications.title: Microsoft Teams
applications.description: FDC3 adapter for the local Microsoft Teams client. When opened here it uses getAgent(); the sideloaded Teams tab joins through Desktop Bridge.

applications.name: FDC3TeamsBot
applications.title: FDC3 Teams Bot
applications.description: Teams @mention bot. Parses @FDC3 AAPL, looks up the instrument, and broadcasts fdc3.instrument through Desktop Bridge.

applications.name: FDC3SlackBot
applications.title: FDC3 Slack Bot
applications.description: Slack @mention bot. Parses @agent AAPL and broadcasts fdc3.instrument through Desktop Bridge.

applications.name: CRDMock
applications.title: CRD Mock Application
applications.description: WPF mock CRD. Sail asks Desktop Bridge to open the App Directory path for this known appId; the process then connects to ws://localhost:5180/bridge.

applications.name: Excel
applications.title: Excel
applications.description: Excel task pane. Registers a ViewInstrument listener through Desktop Bridge and writes the fdc3.instrument ticker into the first empty cell of column A.
